layer: Node VM model/template checks; no browser layout or provider proof
checks: All domain routes generate EN and AR without exceptions
Publication blocked before submitted review and explicit audience confirmation
Family evaluation excludes private note and retains immutable publication during revision
Bill/receipt reject invalid units, over-allocation and missing review
Lost financial response preserves original receipt, allocation and unapplied units
Compensation exception blocks review; approval does not invent earned/paid amount
Scheduled plan differs from effective; claim needs staged proof and review
Recipient review creates distinct accepted/suppressed/disabled/unknown results
Partial media retry affects only failed item and expired-access recovery is explicit
Customer support projection excludes internal notes and write controls
Inventory transfer is paired and insufficient stock changes neither location
Export retains frozen scope through partial progress and failed-job retry
Privacy hold and missing subsystem evidence prevent case closure
Service inspection follows selected row; collector failure never becomes provider outage
Incident proposal and recovery require evidence and explicit review
Identity context requires ready identity; suspension clears selection
Staff changes are reviewed fixtures; no sole-owner transfer endpoint
Session change requires consequence preview and preserves history
Every generic domain state generates both languages without private projection
Import preserves per-row reconciliation and does not create duplicate rows on replay
Offline and native pages stay explicitly unavailable/later concepts
